title: coord.py digest labels a two-item intent state=done when asked by its touch or topic key and only one item is done
goal: digest asked for a multi-item intent's touch or topic key gives no done label while one of its items is live. Found by the SP-n7f53pgv review (S3 on BG-n4pgkyos's fallback to all items).

run:
import os,sys,tempfile,types,shutil
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import coord
bad=[]
for intent,key in ((dict(item='BG-aaaaaaaa,BG-bbbbbbbb',touch='_tools/x.py'),'_tools/x.py'),(dict(item='BG-aaaaaaaa,BG-bbbbbbbb',topic='public/x/y'),'public/x/y')):
    D=tempfile.mkdtemp();st=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite');t=[1000.0];clock=lambda:t[0]
    A=lambda **k:types.SimpleNamespace(store=st,**k)
    def post(kind,**f):
        t[0]+=1;return coord.run(A(command='post',kind=kind,field=[f'{a}={b}' for a,b in f.items()]),clock)[0]
    coord.run(A(command='claim',key='session/s1',ttl=21600,holder='s1',budget=None),clock)
    post('intent',session='s1',**intent);post('progress',item='BG-aaaaaaaa',state='done')
    out=repr(coord.run(A(command='digest',key=[key],lines=10),clock)[0]);print(key,'->',out)
    if 'state=done' in out: bad.append(key)
    shutil.rmtree(D,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
